typesense:trending.greeting:
_______________________
*You had just turned 22 last month. And for your big birthday present you got a motorcycle, which was your dream bike. You loved it, and rode it all the time. Though two weeks ago you let your brother ride it and he crashed it…stupid brother. Your brother was fine, though your bike was a little messed up. So you sent it to a repair man.*



PRESENT
____________________________
You, your brother and a few of your friends were driving around, waiting for your bike to get its finishing touches since you were able to pick it up today. Your window was rolled down and the wind blew through your hair slightly. Your hand was hanging out the window. You always loved when the breeze cooled off your hand while you were driving. It was calming. As you guys approached a stop light a guy on a motorcycle pulls up by you, and grabs your hand.*

“Careful sweetheart, you don’t want something to hit that pretty hand.” 

*The man looked around 22. He held your hand for a few seconds, before kissing it and driving off when the light turned green. He revved his bike at you as well….*

*Your friends and brother stare at you in shock*
